# Free calculators and checks for people who run a small business

> 53 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev, for marketplace sellers, trade contractors, logistics buyers, and small teams preparing compliance evidence. No account, no payment, no upload: every calculation runs in the visitor's own browser and the numbers they type never leave their device.

Each tool is a static page that works offline once opened, and is free with no
gated features. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional
advice or a determination made on anyone's behalf; each page carries its own
limitations.

Every tool listed below is linked at a URL this host serves. The wider
collection runs to 169 tools and will be published at tools.marisstella.dev; that
hostname is not serving yet, so it is named here for context and deliberately
not linked — a link there would resolve to nothing today.

## Trade & contractor bids

- [Change Order Margin Calculator — Price the Added Work](https://marisstella.dev/tools/change-order-margin-calculator/): Price a construction change order from loaded labor, materials, subs, schedule delay and overhead — and see what your contract's markup cap actually leaves you.
- [Subcontractor Cash Flow Planner — Payment Delay Gap](https://marisstella.dev/tools/subcontractor-cashflow-planner/): Free subcontractor cash flow planner: see the funding gap from payment terms, retention and late payment — what bridging it costs, and which lever closes it.
- [Free Contractor Bid Readiness Checklist](https://marisstella.dev/tools/contractor-bid-readiness/): Check a contractor RFP or bid submission for missing documents, owners, and deadline risks. Free, private, and browser-local.
- [Construction Daily Log and Change Order Evidence Pack](https://marisstella.dev/tools/construction-evidence-log/): Free private construction daily log and change order documentation tool for small contractors. Create a dated, reviewable evidence pack in your browser.
- [Job Cost Variance Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/job-margin-variance/): Compare estimated and actual job hours and costs to find the largest job cost variance before your next contractor quote.
- [Appliance Repair Quote Calculator — Repair vs Replace](https://marisstella.dev/tools/appliance-repair-quote-calculator/): Price an appliance repair service call, then see whether finishing the repair still beats recommending replace — customer cost per remaining year versus what you keep if they decline.
- [HVAC Maintenance Contract Pricing Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/hvac-maintenance-contract-calculator/): Free HVAC maintenance contract pricing calculator. Price preventive visits, callbacks, parts reserve, overhead, and target margin without underbidding the agreement.
- [Cleaning Chemical Dilution Cost Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cleaning-dilution-calculator/): Calculate commercial cleaning chemical cost per ready-to-use gallon, bucket, and job from concentrate dilution and supplier price.
- [Roofing Bid Calculator — Price a Reroof by the Square](https://marisstella.dev/tools/roofing-bid-calculator/): Price a residential reroof from roof squares, pitch, waste, and tear-off layers — labor, material, dump, overhead, and the walk-away number. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Painting Bid Calculator — Interior Price Per Sq Ft](https://marisstella.dev/tools/painting-bid-calculator/): Price an interior painting job from production rates: walls, ceilings, trim, and doors — plus paint, payroll burden, overhead, and the walk-away number. See why a $2 per square foot floor bid loses money.
- [Concrete Bid Calculator — Driveway & Patio by Cubic Yard](https://marisstella.dev/tools/concrete-bid-calculator/): Price a concrete driveway, patio, or slab from cubic yards, form footage, finish labor, and access — not a flat price per square foot. See yards to order, price per yard, and the walk-away number.
- [Lawn Care Bid Calculator — Price a Mowing Stop](https://marisstella.dev/tools/lawn-care-bid-calculator/): Price a lawn care route stop from production rates: turf, beds, edging, travel time, fuel, dump, and margin — plus price per visit, in-season monthly, honest annual, and the walk-away number.
- [Fence Bid Calculator — Posts, Gates, and Tear-Out](https://marisstella.dev/tools/fence-bid-calculator/): Price a fence installation from posts, terminals, gates, tear-out, and digging conditions. See installed price per foot, effective hourly rate, and the walk-away number before you send the bid.

## Compliance checks & evidence records

- [Chargeback Evidence Packet Builder for Ecommerce Sellers](https://marisstella.dev/tools/chargeback-evidence-packet/): Build a structured chargeback response packet from your order, delivery, and customer-contact evidence. Free, private, and browser-local.
- [Free Grant Reporting Deadline Tracker for Small Nonprofits](https://marisstella.dev/tools/grant-reporting-tracker/): Track nonprofit grant reporting deadlines, restricted balances, and award review status in a private browser-based tracker. No account or upload required.
- [Vendor Change Evidence — free vendor policy diff checker](https://marisstella.dev/tools/vendor-change-evidence/): Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that compares two dated vendor policy snapshots (privacy, terms, subprocessors, security) in your browser and reports what changed. Runs entirely client-side.
- [Public-Record Watch — free public register change checker](https://marisstella.dev/tools/public-record-watch/): Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that compares two dated public-register snapshots (licenses, permits, registrations) in your browser and reports what changed. Runs entirely client-side.
- [FIFO Pick Evidence — Free Warehouse Pick-Log Report](https://marisstella.dev/tools/fifo-pick-evidence/): Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that reads a warehouse pick-log CSV in your browser and reports FIFO pick-order exceptions and missing or ill-formed timestamps before a customer audit. Runs entirely client-side.
- [Backup Verification Evidence — Compare It to Last Night](https://marisstella.dev/tools/backup-verification-evidence/): Drop backup-evidence run records in your browser to see whether last night's archive shrank or a verified job quietly got worse. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Git branch cleanup review — which stale branches are safe to delete?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/repository-branch-hygiene/): Paste a branch snapshot and see which stale Git branches are delete candidates and which still hold unique work. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded and nothing is deleted.
- [npm Deployment Evidence — Free Lockfile Surface Report](https://marisstella.dev/tools/npm-deployment-evidence/): Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that reads a package-lock.json in your browser and shows which npm dependencies reach your deployed app versus which are build- or test-only. Runs entirely client-side.
- [Grant Deadline Tracker for Small Nonprofits](https://marisstella.dev/tools/grant-deadline-tracker/): Free private grant deadline and reporting tracker for small nonprofits. Find overdue obligations, see award funds remaining, and compare hiring a grant writer against the cash a late report puts at risk.
- [Shopify Accessibility Evidence Report](https://marisstella.dev/tools/shopify-a11y-evidence/): Turn a Shopify storefront's axe-core JSON export into a dated, readable accessibility evidence record. Runs locally in your browser.

## Marketplace seller tools

- [Airbnb vs Vrbo Host Payout Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/str-host-payout-calculator/): Free short-term rental host payout calculator: compare Airbnb’s 15.5% 2026 host-only fee with Vrbo (5% + 3%) and direct booking. See annual take-home, the nightly raise that restores your old 3% payout, and how much occupancy you can lose going direct and still break even.
- [eBay Fee & Profit Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ebay-fee-calculator/): Calculate eBay order profit, margin, ROI, and break-even resale price after fees, shipping, and cost of goods — then see what a return rate still leaves, whether a partial refund beats taking the return, whether Authenticity Guarantee still pays after the hub label, whether local pickup still beats the label after no-shows, whether keeping a lot still beats splitting it into singles, whether a Standard Envelope still beats a tracked label after item-not-received claims, whether combining two sold items still beats two labels, whether a seller-initiated offer still beats waiting for Buy It Now, whether Promoted Offsite still pays after a bill that is charged even if they bounce, whether Promoted Listings Standard still pays after the cut on a sale you already had, whether Promoted Listings Advanced still pays after a click bill that is charged even if they bounce, whether a quantity discount still beats selling separately, whether a seller coupon still beats staying listed or dropping the price, whether requiring immediate payment still beats unpaid checkouts, whether Top Rated Plus still covers free returns after the fee discount, whether Managed Returns still beats buying the return label yourself, whether offering international still leaves a profit at this list, whether Global Shipping Program still beats buying the international label, whether a store subscription still beats the no-store rate, whether an incoming Best Offer still beats waiting for list, whether free shipping still beats charging the buyer after a typed sell-through lift, whether skip still beats shipping insurance or signature confirmation after item-not-received claims, whether an eBay shipping label still beats Pirate Ship after claims and upload time, whether auction beats Buy It Now after sell-through, and compare nearby listing prices before you reprice.
- [Amazon FBA vs FBM Profit Calculator — Placement vs Freight](https://marisstella.dev/tools/amazon-fba-calculator/): Free Amazon FBA vs FBM calculator: compare fulfillment paths after expected returns. Get net profit, max buy cost, the return rate that wipes the listing, when inbound placement still beats split freight, and whether aged inventory still beats a removal.
- [Etsy Profit Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/etsy-profit-calculator/): Calculate Etsy order profit after listing, transaction, payment, offsite ad, shipping, material, and other costs. Compare whether Etsy Plus credits cover the $10 fee, whether a personalization still pays, whether on-site Etsy Ads still leave a profit after ACOS, whether Offsite Ads still leave a profit at 12% or 15%, whether a production-partner quote still pays after you run out of handmade hours, whether chasing Star Seller still beats staying unsigned, whether a 20% shop sale still beats staying full price, whether free shipping still leaves a profit, whether an Etsy shipping label still beats Pirate Ship, and whether auto-renew still covers a slow listing.
- [Walmart Marketplace Fee Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/walmart-marketplace-calculator/): Free Walmart Marketplace calculator: compare WFS vs seller-fulfilled profit, apply the referral-fee floor, and see whether matching a lower price still leaves money after Buy Box take.
- [TikTok Shop Fee Calculator — Affiliate and Returns](https://marisstella.dev/tools/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/): Free TikTok Shop profit calculator. See referral fees, creator commission, returns that keep the affiliate payout, and the announced 1 Oct 2026 8% + 1.5% schedule on the same SKU.
- [Reverb Fee Calculator — Offer vs List, Cash vs Consign](https://marisstella.dev/tools/reverb-fee-calculator/): See what a Reverb sale leaves after marketplace, payment, shipping, and gear cost — whether a buyer offer still beats eBay, whether free shipping still beats charging postage, whether Reverb Safe Shipping still beats your own label, whether consigning or taking a shop cash offer still beats listing it yourself, and how big a partial refund still beats taking a return.
- [Faire Seller Fee Calculator — First Order vs Reorder](https://marisstella.dev/tools/faire-wholesale-calculator/): Free Faire wholesale fee calculator for brands: net payout after 15% commission, the $10 new-customer fee, and payout-speed processing. Compare first orders, Faire Direct, Open House, Promoted Listings after last-click organic, next-day payout after carrying cost, Pay Now leftover after Faire remittance wait, and whether a keep-it credit still beats taking a return.

## Back-office money & contracts

- [Seller Net Sheet Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/seller-net-sheet/): Free seller net sheet: see cash at closing after listing commission, optional buyer-broker compensation, concessions, title, and payoff. Compare two offers — the higher price is not always more cash.
- [SaaS Price Increase Churn Calculator — Price Impact](https://marisstella.dev/tools/subscription-price-impact/): Test a SaaS price increase and see the maximum churn your recurring revenue can absorb before the change stops paying off.
- [SaaS Seat True-Up Calculator — Find Unused Spend](https://marisstella.dev/tools/saas-seat-true-up/): Calculate unused SaaS seats and avoidable renewal spend privately in your browser. No account or upload required.
- [CAM Reconciliation Calculator for Commercial Leases](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cam-reconciliation-check/): Free CAM reconciliation calculator for small commercial landlords and tenants. Check area-share math, credits, billed charges, and variance privately in your browser.
- [Invoice Payment Terms Calculator — Net 30 Late Fee](https://marisstella.dev/tools/invoice-payment-terms-calculator/): Calculate invoice due dates, when cash actually lands on your client's payment run, late-fee scenarios, cash-flow exposure, whether a 2/10 Net 30 discount still beats waiting, and whether factoring still beats waiting after your carrying cost.
- [Cash Runway Planner for Small Businesses](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cash-runway-planner/): Forecast when invoices and recurring bills could create a cash shortfall for your small business, including one-off payments like a quarterly tax bill or an insurance renewal, and see which payment to move.
- [Supplier Rate Break-Even Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/vendor-rate-break-even/): Free supplier, subcontractor, and equipment rate break-even calculator. Compare fixed fees, per-job costs, savings, and payback volume.
- [Music Lesson Pricing Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/music-lesson-break-even/): Free music lesson pricing calculator for independent teachers. Include cancellations, preparation, travel, studio costs, and target pay to find a sustainable lesson price.

## Service business pricing & quotes

- [Pool Route Pricing Calculator — Price Weekly Accounts](https://marisstella.dev/tools/pool-route-pricing/): Price recurring pool service accounts after labor, drive time, chemicals, and overhead. Free private pool route pricing calculator for independent operators.
- [Translator Project Quote Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/translator-project-quote/): Free private translator quote calculator. Price new words, fuzzy matches, QA, DTP, rush work, and a minimum project fee in your browser.
- [Porta Potty Event Quote Calculator — Restroom Rental Bid](https://marisstella.dev/tools/portable-restroom-event-quote/): Price a portable restroom (porta potty) event rental from days on site, pump-outs, and two round trips — not a Saturday headcount special. See walk-away price, price per unit-day, and a starting fleet estimate.
- [Commercial Photography Licensing Quote Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/commercial-photo-license-calculator/): Price commercial photography usage rights by channel, term, territory, and exclusivity. Free local-first quote worksheet for photographers.
- [Mobile Notary & Loan Signing Fee Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/notary-trip-quote/): Price a mobile notary appointment from mileage, drive time, print pages, witnesses and waiting — then test a signing service's flat offer against what you actually earn per hour after paper, toner and fuel.
- [Booth Rent vs Commission Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/booth-rent-vs-commission/): Free booth rent vs commission calculator for hair stylists, barbers, and nail techs. Compare take-home and hourly pay on your own book after rent, card fees, backbar, and unpaid hours.

## Logistics, freight & cloud cost

- [Medical Courier Route Calculator — Per-Stop Pricing](https://marisstella.dev/tools/medical-courier-route-margin/): Free medical courier route calculator: margin per stop and vehicle-hour after paid wait, deadhead and overhead — plus the per-stop rate to quote.
- [Owner Operator CPM Calculator — Deadhead-Adjusted Rate](https://marisstella.dev/tools/owner-operator-cpm-calculator/): Free owner-operator CPM calculator: fuel, truck note, insurance, and deadhead miles in one week. See all-in cost per mile and the loaded rate that actually covers the empty ones.
- [3PL Cost Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/3pl-quote-normalizer/): Compare a third-party logistics quote with in-house fulfillment costs, minimum monthly spend, and true cost per order.
- [Freight Accessorial Invoice Auditor](https://marisstella.dev/tools/freight-accessorial-auditor/): Audit freight accessorial invoices for duplicate, over-expected, and missing-code charges before you pay. Free, private, and runs in your browser.
- [LTL Freight Class Estimator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ltl-freight-class-estimator/): Estimate LTL freight class from pallet dimensions, weight, and piece count — then see the packed height that reaches the next class down, and the height at which a carrier remeasure re-rates the shipment.
- [Cloud Egress Cost Calculator for S3 Storage](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cloud-egress-calculator/): Compare monthly S3-compatible storage, request, and data egress costs for a real workload. Free, private, and runs in your browser.

## More free tools

- [Tender Bid Readiness Checker for Small Contractors](https://marisstella.dev/tools/tender-bid-readiness/): Paste a public tender and get a fast bid-readiness checklist for deadlines, bonds, insurance, certifications, questions, and submission instructions. Runs privately in your browser.
- [Sponsor Ready — free GitHub Sponsors readiness checklist](https://marisstella.dev/tools/sponsor-ready/): Free, no-signup checklist that scores a public GitHub repo against the signals that correlate with attracting GitHub Sponsors, and tells you exactly what to fix first.
